svg.title: linear-chunkwise
svg.desc: Chunkwise form for N = 16 toy tokens in chunks of C = 4: only the four diagonal 4×4 blocks are computed as small masked attention; everything below them is carried by a state S passed between chunks. Our count per head with d = 128, C = 64, N = 32K: chunkwise about 98K FLOPs per token in 512 sequential steps, recurrent 66K FLOPs per token in 32,768 matrix-vector steps, quadratic form 8.4M FLOPs per token.
